preconditions.description: The message must be a string.
The hashtag must be a string.
The hashtag must start with a '#'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == message.replace(hashtag + ' ', '', 1) if hashtag + ' ' in message else message.replace(hashtag, '', 1)
postconditions.description: The function returns the message with the first occurrence of the hashtag removed, including the trailing space if present.
